research_question: Can an independent positioned-text reader convert high-recall direct-VLM proposals into evidence-grounded, selectively accepted interval actions without silent repair?
acceptance_rule: complete top and bottom boundaries agree with one RapidOCR positioned candidate
the positioned candidate retains at least one source bbox
the interval has non-negative top and positive thickness
accepted intervals form a monotonic non-overlapping subsequence
document_complete_acceptance_rule: the two readers emit the same number of intervals
the accepted sequence starts at source depth zero
every rendered page has valid VLM JSON
the VLM emitted no invalid numeric range
